en.headline: AFCD captures 17 unattended dogs in special operation
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said it has captured 17 unattended dogs in 25 operations across high-risk areas since launching a four-month drive on 8 October.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said on Friday that, as of 26 November, it had conducted 25 capture operations under a four-month special drive launched on 8 October targeting high-risk locations where dog attacks or gatherings of stray dogs had occurred.

Officers captured 17 unattended dogs in Yuen Long, North District, Lantau Island, Kwun Tong and Cheung Chau. Two of the dogs were microchipped. All were taken to Animal Management Centres for observation.

The department will check lost-and-found records to identify keepers and may prosecute where evidence shows legal breaches. Healthy, gentle dogs without traceable keepers will be transferred to partner animal welfare organisations for sterilisation and public adoption. A spokesman said uncontrolled dogs in dense urban areas can pose risks to public and animal safety.

zh.headline: 漁護署特別行動捕捉17隻無人看管狗隻
zh.dek: 漁護署表示，自10月8日展開為期四個月特別行動以來，截至26日已進行25次捕捉行動，共捕捉17隻無人看管狗隻。
body: 漁農自然護理署周五表示，自10月8日展開為期四個月的特別行動以來，截至11月26日，已在高風險地點進行25次捕捉行動，包括曾發生狗隻襲擊途人或有流浪狗聚集的地方。
署方在元朗、北區、大嶼山、觀塘及長洲共捕捉17隻無人看管狗隻，其中兩隻有晶片。所有狗隻已送往動物管理中心觀察。
漁護署會核對報失紀錄以確定是否有畜養人，如有證據證明違反法例將提出檢控。未能尋回畜養人而身體健康及性情溫馴的狗隻，會轉交伙伴動物福利機構絕育後安排領養。發言人指，在高密度都市環境下，無人管束的狗隻可能對公眾及動物安全構成風險。
